id-20260825-news-1.title: Rupiah and IHSG Strengthen Following Kevin Warsh's Inaugural Speech at Jackson Hole, Here Are the Signals Caught by the Market

segments.src: Nilai tukar rupiah dan Indeks Harga Saham Gabungan (IHSG) kompak menguat pada perdagangan terbaru, setelah Ketua The Federal Reserve (The Fed) Kevin Warsh menyampaikan pidato kebijakan pertamanya di simposium tahunan Jackson Hole.
segments.tr: The rupiah exchange rate and the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) jointly strengthened in the latest trading session, after Federal Reserve (The Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh delivered his first policy speech at the annual Jackson Hole symposium.

segments.src: Pasar keuangan domestik merespons positif nada pidato tersebut, yang oleh sejumlah analis dibaca sebagai sinyal awal bahwa bank sentral Amerika Serikat mulai membuka ruang bagi pelonggaran kebijakan moneter.
segments.tr: The domestic financial market responded positively to the tone of the speech, which a number of analysts read as an early signal that the United States central bank is starting to open room for monetary policy easing.

segments.src: ## Rupiah Tembus Level Rp17.690
segments.tr: ## Rupiah Pierces the Rp17,690 Level

segments.src: Berdasarkan data perdagangan di pasar spot, rupiah bergerak menguat hingga menembus level Rp17.690 per dolar Amerika Serikat.
segments.tr: Based on spot market trading data, the rupiah moved up to pierce the level of Rp17,690 per US dollar.

segments.src: Penguatan ini melanjutkan tren positif yang mulai terlihat sejak sesi perdagangan sebelumnya, seiring meredanya kekhawatiran pelaku pasar terhadap arah kebijakan suku bunga The Fed dalam beberapa bulan ke depan.
segments.tr: This strengthening continues the positive trend that began to be seen from the previous trading session, along with the easing of market participants' concerns regarding the direction of The Fed's interest rate policy in the coming months.

segments.src: Sejumlah ekonom menilai penguatan rupiah tidak lepas dari membaiknya sentimen terhadap aset-aset di negara berkembang (emerging market), setelah pidato Warsh dinilai lebih akomodatif dibandingkan ekspektasi pasar sebelumnya.
segments.tr: A number of economists assess that the rupiah's strengthening is inseparable from improving sentiment toward assets in emerging markets, after Warsh's speech was considered more accommodative than previous market expectations.

segments.src: Meski demikian, para analis mengingatkan bahwa pergerakan nilai tukar tetap perlu dicermati mengingat dinamika eksternal yang masih dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, analysts remind that exchange rate movements still need to be watched given external dynamics that can still change at any time.

segments.src: ## IHSG Ikut Terangkat Sentimen Positif
segments.tr: ## IHSG Lifted by Positive Sentiment

segments.src: Sentimen serupa turut menjalar ke pasar saham domestik.
segments.tr: A similar sentiment also spread to the domestic stock market.

segments.src: IHSG mencatatkan penguatan pada perdagangan setelah pidato tersebut dipublikasikan, dengan mayoritas sektor saham bergerak di zona hijau.
segments.tr: The IHSG recorded an increase in trading after the speech was published, with the majority of stock sectors moving in the green zone.

segments.src: Saham-saham berbasis konsumsi dan perbankan disebut menjadi salah satu penggerak utama penguatan indeks, seiring ekspektasi pasar terhadap potensi penurunan biaya dana apabila arah kebijakan The Fed benar-benar melunak.
segments.tr: Consumption and banking-based stocks were cited as one of the main drivers of the index's strengthening, along with market expectations of the potential for lower cost of funds if The Fed's policy direction truly softens.

segments.src: Para pelaku pasar menyebut bahwa penguatan IHSG kali ini lebih didorong oleh faktor sentimen jangka pendek.
segments.tr: Market participants noted that this time the IHSG's strengthening was more driven by short-term sentiment factors.

segments.src: Oleh karena itu, sejumlah analis mengingatkan investor untuk tetap mencermati data ekonomi lanjutan sebelum mengambil kesimpulan mengenai arah tren pasar ke depan.
segments.tr: Therefore, a number of analysts reminded investors to keep observing further economic data before drawing conclusions regarding the future direction of the market trend.

segments.src: ## Sinyal yang Ditangkap Pasar dari Pidato Warsh
segments.tr: ## Signals Caught by the Market from Warsh's Speech

segments.src: Dalam pidatonya, Warsh disebut menyinggung sejumlah indikator ekonomi AS, termasuk perkembangan inflasi dan kondisi pasar tenaga kerja, tanpa memberikan kepastian eksplisit mengenai waktu maupun besaran pemangkasan suku bunga.
segments.tr: In his speech, Warsh was reported to have touched on a number of US economic indicators, including inflation developments and labor market conditions, without providing explicit certainty regarding the timing or scale of interest rate cuts.

segments.src: Namun, nada bicara yang dianggap lebih lunak dibandingkan pejabat The Fed sebelumnya cukup untuk mengubah ekspektasi pasar terhadap arah kebijakan moneter AS.
segments.tr: However, the tone of voice considered softer than previous Fed officials was enough to change market expectations regarding the direction of US monetary policy.

segments.src: "Pasar cenderung menangkap nuansa dari setiap pilihan kata pejabat bank sentral, terutama dalam forum sepenting Jackson Hole," ujar salah satu pelaku pasar yang mengikuti pergerakan nilai tukar, seperti dikutip dari sejumlah laporan pasar.
segments.tr: "The market tends to catch the nuance from every choice of words by central bank officials, especially in a forum as important as Jackson Hole," said one market participant who followed exchange rate movements, as quoted from a number of market reports.

segments.src: Ia menambahkan bahwa arah kebijakan The Fed ke depan masih akan sangat bergantung pada data ekonomi yang dirilis dalam beberapa pekan mendatang.
segments.tr: He added that the future direction of The Fed's policy will still heavily depend on economic data released in the coming weeks.

segments.src: ## Yield Obligasi AS Masih Bergejolak
segments.tr: ## US Bond Yields Still Volatile

segments.src: Di sisi lain, imbal hasil (yield) obligasi pemerintah AS tenor acuan dilaporkan masih bergerak fluktuatif pasca-pidato tersebut.
segments.tr: On the other hand, the yield on benchmark US government bonds was reported to still move fluctuatingly post-speech.

segments.src: Pergerakan yield yang belum sepenuhnya stabil ini menjadi salah satu indikasi bahwa pelaku pasar global masih mencerna secara hati-hati implikasi dari pernyataan Warsh, alih-alih langsung meyakini adanya kepastian arah kebijakan baru.
segments.tr: This yield movement, which is not yet fully stable, is one indication that global market participants are still carefully digesting the implications of Warsh's statement, rather than immediately believing in the certainty of a new policy direction.

segments.src: Sejumlah analis pasar keuangan menilai, volatilitas yield tersebut wajar terjadi di tengah masa transisi kepemimpinan The Fed, di mana investor global masih menakar gaya komunikasi dan preferensi kebijakan pimpinan baru bank sentral tersebut.
segments.tr: A number of financial market analysts assess that the yield volatility is natural amid the transition period of The Fed's leadership, where global investors are still measuring the communication style and policy preferences of the central bank's new leader.

segments.src: ## Apa Artinya bagi Pasar Domestik
segments.tr: ## What It Means for the Domestic Market

segments.src: Analis dalam negeri menyebut penguatan rupiah dan IHSG sebagai respons wajar terhadap perubahan sentimen global, namun menekankan pentingnya kehati-hatian dalam membaca arah pasar selanjutnya.
segments.tr: Domestic analysts called the strengthening of the rupiah and IHSG a natural response to changing global sentiment, but emphasized the importance of caution in reading the subsequent market direction.

segments.src: Faktor-faktor domestik seperti neraca perdagangan, arus modal asing, serta kebijakan Bank Indonesia turut disebut akan memengaruhi keberlanjutan tren penguatan ini.
segments.tr: Domestic factors such as the trade balance, foreign capital flows, and Bank Indonesia's policy are also said to influence the sustainability of this strengthening trend.

segments.src: Pergerakan pasar keuangan, baik nilai tukar maupun indeks saham, pada dasarnya bersifat dinamis dan dipengaruhi banyak variabel yang dapat berubah dalam waktu singkat.
segments.tr: Financial market movements, both exchange rates and stock indices, are essentially dynamic and influenced by many variables that can change in a short time.

segments.src: Masyarakat maupun pelaku pasar disarankan untuk terus memantau perkembangan data ekonomi resmi dan pernyataan otoritas moneter, baik dari The Fed maupun Bank Indonesia, sebagai referensi utama sebelum mengambil keputusan keuangan.
segments.tr: The public and market participants are advised to continue monitoring the developments of official economic data and statements from monetary authorities, both from The Fed and Bank Indonesia, as a main reference before making financial decisions.

segments.src: Informasi dalam artikel ini disusun untuk tujuan pemberitaan umum dan bukan merupakan rekomendasi atau saran investasi.
segments.tr: The information in this article is compiled for general reporting purposes and does not constitute a recommendation or investment advice.

id-20260825-news-3.title: IEU-CEPA Targeted to be Signed in October 2026, Import Duties on Indonesian Products to Europe to Decrease Despite Domestic Supply Chain Deemed Not Fully Ready

segments.src: Kementerian Perdagangan (Kemendag) menargetkan perjanjian kemitraan ekonomi komprehensif antara Indonesia dan Uni Eropa, yang dikenal dengan sebutan IEU-CEPA (Indonesia-European Union Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement), dapat ditandatangani pada Oktober 2026.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Trade (Kemendag) is targeting the comprehensive economic partnership agreement between Indonesia and the European Union, known as the IEU-CEPA (Indonesia-European Union Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement), to be signed in October 2026.

segments.src: Setelah proses ratifikasi di kedua pihak rampung, implementasi awal perjanjian ini diperkirakan mulai berjalan pada 2027.
segments.tr: Once the ratification process by both parties is complete, the initial implementation of this agreement is expected to begin in 2027.

segments.src: Jika target tersebut tercapai, IEU-CEPA akan menjadi salah satu perjanjian dagang paling signifikan yang pernah dirampungkan Indonesia, mengingat Uni Eropa merupakan salah satu pasar ekspor nontradisional terbesar sekaligus mitra investasi penting bagi Indonesia selama ini.
segments.tr: If this target is achieved, the IEU-CEPA will become one of the most significant trade agreements ever finalized by Indonesia, considering that the European Union has long been one of the largest non-traditional export markets and a key investment partner for Indonesia.

segments.src: ## Apa yang Diatur dalam IEU-CEPA
segments.tr: ## What is Regulated in the IEU-CEPA

segments.src: Secara garis besar, perundingan IEU-CEPA mencakup penghapusan atau pengurangan bea masuk untuk ribuan pos tarif produk asal Indonesia yang selama ini dikenakan tarif tinggi saat masuk ke pasar Eropa.
segments.tr: Broadly speaking, the IEU-CEPA negotiations cover the elimination or reduction of import duties for thousands of tariff lines for products from Indonesia that have previously been subject to high tariffs when entering the European market.

segments.src: Sektor yang kerap disebut berpotensi paling diuntungkan antara lain produk berbasis kelapa sawit dan turunannya, tekstil dan produk tekstil, alas kaki, furnitur, produk perikanan, hingga sejumlah komoditas pertanian olahan.
segments.tr: Sectors often cited as having the most potential to benefit include palm oil-based products and their derivatives, textiles and textile products, footwear, furniture, fishery products, and a number of processed agricultural commodities.

segments.src: Selain soal tarif, perjanjian ini juga mencakup pembahasan isu-isu nontarif seperti standar keberlanjutan, ketertelusuran rantai pasok, hak kekayaan intelektual, serta kemudahan investasi dua arah.
segments.tr: In addition to tariffs, this agreement also includes discussions on non-tariff issues such as sustainability standards, supply chain traceability, intellectual property rights, and the facilitation of two-way investment.

segments.src: Uni Eropa dikenal memiliki standar teknis dan lingkungan yang ketat, sehingga aspek nontarif ini pada praktiknya kerap menjadi tantangan tersendiri bagi eksportir, terlepas dari besaran tarif yang berlaku.
segments.tr: The European Union is known for having strict technical and environmental standards, so these non-tariff aspects often pose their own challenges for exporters in practice, regardless of the applicable tariff rates.

segments.src: ## Peluang bagi Eksportir Nasional
segments.tr: ## Opportunities for National Exporters

segments.src: Bagi pelaku usaha berorientasi ekspor, pemangkasan bea masuk berpotensi meningkatkan daya saing harga produk Indonesia dibandingkan negara pesaing yang belum memiliki perjanjian dagang serupa dengan Uni Eropa.
segments.tr: For export-oriented businesses, the reduction of import duties has the potential to increase the price competitiveness of Indonesian products compared to competitor countries that do not yet have similar trade agreements with the European Union.

segments.src: Sejumlah asosiasi industri menyambut positif rencana ini karena dapat membuka ruang perluasan pasar, terutama bagi produk-produk yang selama ini terkendala tarif tinggi saat masuk ke Eropa.
segments.tr: A number of industry associations have welcomed this plan positively because it can open up space for market expansion, especially for products that have been constrained by high tariffs when entering Europe.

segments.src: Pemerintah juga memandang IEU-CEPA sebagai bagian dari strategi diversifikasi pasar ekspor, agar ketergantungan pada beberapa mitra dagang utama dapat dikurangi secara bertahap.
segments.tr: The government also views the IEU-CEPA as part of an export market diversification strategy, so that dependence on a few main trading partners can be reduced gradually.

segments.src: ## Kekhawatiran Pelaku Industri soal Kesiapan Rantai Pasok
segments.tr: ## Industry Players' Concerns Regarding Supply Chain Readiness

segments.src: Di sisi lain, sejumlah pelaku industri mengingatkan bahwa peluang besar dari pembukaan pasar Eropa ini perlu diimbangi dengan kesiapan di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: On the other hand, a number of industry players have warned that the great opportunity from opening the European market needs to be balanced with readiness domestically.

segments.src: Beberapa catatan yang mengemuka antara lain:
segments.tr: Some notes that have emerged include:

segments.src: - **Standar keberlanjutan dan sertifikasi.** Uni Eropa menerapkan berbagai regulasi terkait keberlanjutan dan ketertelusuran produk, sehingga produsen dalam negeri perlu memastikan proses produksi dan rantai pasok mereka memenuhi persyaratan tersebut agar dapat memanfaatkan penurunan tarif secara maksimal.
segments.tr: - **Sustainability standards and certification.** The European Union applies various regulations related to sustainability and product traceability, so domestic producers need to ensure their production processes and supply chains meet these requirements in order to maximize the use of tariff reductions.

segments.src: - **Kapasitas produksi dan skala industri kecil-menengah.** Tidak semua pelaku usaha, khususnya skala kecil dan menengah, memiliki kapasitas produksi maupun pemahaman prosedur ekspor yang memadai untuk langsung menyasar pasar Eropa begitu perjanjian berlaku.
segments.tr: - **Production capacity and small-medium industry scale.** Not all business players, especially those on a small and medium scale, have the production capacity or understanding of export procedures adequate to immediately target the European market once the agreement takes effect.

segments.src: - **Infrastruktur logistik dan sertifikasi produk.** Proses sertifikasi, pengujian mutu, hingga logistik ekspor ke Eropa dinilai masih memerlukan penguatan agar produk dapat memenuhi tenggat dan standar yang diminta pembeli di sana.
segments.tr: - **Logistics infrastructure and product certification.** The processes of certification, quality testing, and export logistics to Europe are considered to still require strengthening so that products can meet the deadlines and standards requested by buyers there.

segments.src: Sejumlah pelaku usaha menilai penting bagi pemerintah untuk menyiapkan masa transisi yang jelas, termasuk pendampingan teknis dan insentif bagi industri yang ingin menyesuaikan proses produksinya dengan standar Eropa, agar manfaat pemangkasan tarif tidak hanya dinikmati oleh eksportir besar yang sudah mapan.
segments.tr: A number of business players believe it is important for the government to prepare a clear transition period, including technical assistance and incentives for industries that want to adjust their production processes to European standards, so that the benefits of tariff cuts are not only enjoyed by large, established exporters.

segments.src: ## Langkah Selanjutnya
segments.tr: ## Next Steps

segments.src: Kemendag menyatakan proses perundingan masih terus berjalan hingga mendekati target penandatanganan pada Oktober 2026.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Trade stated that the negotiation process is still ongoing as it approaches the signing target in October 2026.

segments.src: Setelah penandatanganan, perjanjian ini masih harus melalui proses ratifikasi di parlemen Indonesia maupun di tingkat Uni Eropa sebelum benar-benar berlaku secara resmi.
segments.tr: After signing, this agreement must still go through a ratification process in the Indonesian parliament and at the European Union level before it truly comes into effect officially.

segments.src: Pelaku usaha diimbau untuk mulai memetakan kesiapan produk dan proses produksinya sejak dini, termasuk mempelajari persyaratan teknis pasar Eropa, agar begitu perjanjian ini berlaku pada 2027 mendatang, manfaat penurunan bea masuk dapat langsung dimanfaatkan secara optimal alih-alih terkendala isu kepatuhan di kemudian hari.
segments.tr: Business players are advised to start mapping the readiness of their products and production processes early, including studying the technical requirements of the European market, so that once this agreement takes effect in 2027, the benefits of import duty reductions can be immediately utilized optimally instead of being hindered by compliance issues later on.

id-20260825-news-2.title: Marketplace Tax Postponed Until October, Purbaya Prioritizes Public Purchasing Power

segments.src: ## Penundaan Pungutan PPh Marketplace
segments.tr: ## Postponement of Marketplace Income Tax Collection

segments.src: Rencana penerapan pemotongan Pajak Penghasilan (PPh) sebesar 0,5 persen bagi pedagang di platform *e-commerce* resmi ditunda.
segments.tr: The plan to implement a 0.5 percent Income Tax (PPh) deduction for merchants on *e-commerce* platforms has been officially postponed.

segments.src: Aturan yang sedianya mulai berlaku pada 1 Agustus ini batal diberlakukan setelah Menteri Keuangan Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa menyampaikan bahwa pemerintah memutuskan untuk mengulur waktu pelaksanaannya hingga Oktober mendatang.
segments.tr: The rule, which was originally scheduled to take effect on August 1, was canceled after Minister of Finance Purbaya Yudhi Sadewa stated that the government decided to delay its implementation until next October.

segments.src: Kebijakan pemotongan pajak ini sebelumnya diarahkan untuk diterapkan melalui sejumlah platform besar seperti Tokopedia, Shopee, Lazada, dan Blibli, yang bertindak sebagai pihak pemungut pajak penghasilan dari transaksi para pelaku usaha di platform mereka.
segments.tr: This tax deduction policy was previously directed to be implemented through a number of major platforms such as Tokopedia, Shopee, Lazada, and Blibli, which act as income tax collectors from the transactions of business actors on their platforms.

segments.src: ## Alasan di Balik Penundaan
segments.tr: ## Reasons Behind the Postponement

segments.src: Menurut keterangan yang disampaikan Purbaya, penundaan ini diambil dengan pertimbangan utama menjaga daya beli masyarakat serta konsumsi rumah tangga yang menjadi salah satu penopang utama pertumbuhan ekonomi nasional.
segments.tr: According to the statement delivered by Purbaya, this postponement was taken with the primary consideration of maintaining public purchasing power and household consumption, which are key pillars of national economic growth.

segments.src: Penerapan pungutan baru di tengah kondisi ekonomi saat ini dinilai berpotensi membebani pelaku usaha kecil dan menengah yang mengandalkan platform digital sebagai kanal penjualan utama.
segments.tr: The implementation of the new levy amidst current economic conditions is considered to potentially burden small and medium-sized business actors who rely on digital platforms as their main sales channels.

segments.src: Purbaya juga membuka opsi bahwa masa penundaan ini masih dapat diperpanjang lagi apabila kondisi perekonomian dan daya beli masyarakat dinilai belum cukup kuat untuk menyerap kebijakan pajak baru tersebut.
segments.tr: Purbaya also opened up the option that this postponement period could still be extended if economic conditions and public purchasing power are judged not yet strong enough to absorb the new tax policy.

segments.src: Dengan kata lain, Oktober bukan tenggat yang bersifat final, melainkan evaluasi awal yang akan terus dipantau oleh pemerintah.
segments.tr: In other words, October is not a final deadline, but rather an initial evaluation that will continue to be monitored by the government.

segments.src: ## Respons Pelaku Usaha dan Platform
segments.tr: ## Response from Business Actors and Platforms

segments.src: Kalangan pelaku usaha daring menyambut baik keputusan penundaan ini.
segments.tr: Online business circles welcomed this postponement decision.

segments.src: Sejumlah pedagang *online* menilai kebijakan tersebut memberi ruang bernapas di tengah persaingan harga yang ketat serta biaya operasional yang terus meningkat.
segments.tr: A number of *online* merchants considered that the policy provides breathing room amid tight price competition and continuously increasing operational costs.

segments.src: Sementara itu, platform-platform *e-commerce* yang sebelumnya telah bersiap menjadi pihak pemungut pajak turut menyesuaikan jadwal implementasi sistem pemotongan sesuai arahan terbaru dari Kementerian Keuangan.
segments.tr: Meanwhile, *e-commerce* platforms that had previously prepared to become tax collectors are also adjusting their system implementation schedules according to the latest directions from the Ministry of Finance.

segments.src: ## Fokus Pemerintah pada Stabilitas Ekonomi
segments.tr: ## Government Focus on Economic Stability

segments.src: Langkah ini sejalan dengan sejumlah kebijakan lain yang belakangan ditempuh pemerintah untuk menjaga stabilitas konsumsi domestik, mengingat sektor rumah tangga masih menjadi kontributor terbesar terhadap Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) Indonesia.
segments.tr: This step is in line with a number of other policies recently taken by the government to maintain domestic consumption stability, given that the household sector remains the largest contributor to Indonesia's Gross Domestic Product (GDP).

segments.src: Dengan menunda pungutan pajak marketplace, pemerintah berharap momentum belanja masyarakat, khususnya di platform digital, tetap terjaga tanpa tekanan tambahan dari sisi biaya.
segments.tr: By postponing the marketplace tax levy, the government hopes that the momentum of public spending, especially on digital platforms, remains sustained without additional pressure from the cost side.

segments.src: Publik kini menanti kejelasan lebih lanjut mengenai skema final pemotongan PPh 0,5 persen ini, termasuk kemungkinan penyesuaian besaran tarif maupun mekanisme pemungutannya sebelum benar-benar diterapkan pada Oktober mendatang atau periode setelahnya.
segments.tr: The public is now awaiting further clarity regarding the final scheme of this 0.5 percent income tax deduction, including the possibility of tariff rate adjustments or collection mechanisms before it is truly implemented next October or in a subsequent period.
